issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant duplicated instead of imported from canonical source
issues.detail: The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat but is now re-declared on Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat with value 16. Two sibling format classes carrying the same magic number is a data-duplication smell; if the canonical value ever changes, sources will silently diverge. Either keep one canonical definition or document why the value is independent.

issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException while public constructors and SPI registration still hand out instances
issues.detail: Both legacy formats remain SPI-registered with public constructors, so `new Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat()` succeeds and only explodes at index-flush time. Failure should happen at construction (or validation) with a message pointing at Lucene104, not deep in the write path. The read-only invariant deserves explicit documentation on the class and service file.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields demoted from protected to package-private while class remains public abstract
issues.detail: The class is still `public abstract` with a public subclass, yet shared fields (dimension, size, slice, etc.) lost their protected modifier. External subclasses break without a clear signal. Either restore protected, mark the class final/sealed, or make the class package-private — the current shape is inconsistent.

issues.description: Dead numMergeWorkers/mergeExec constructor parameters silently discarded
issues.detail: The legacy constructors still accept numMergeWorkers and mergeExec, run the executor null-check, then discard both since the fields are gone and the writer throws anyway. The signature lies about behavior. Drop the parameters or add a literate comment stating they exist only for source compatibility and are ignored.

issues.description: Lucene99RWV1 test format hardcodes default maxConn/beamWidth instead of using constructor args
issues.detail: The parameterized constructor accepts maxConn and beamWidth but fieldsWriter builds the writer with DEFAULT_MAX_CONN and DEFAULT_BEAM_WIDTH (and 1 merge worker). Tests varying these parameters will silently exercise defaults. Thread the fields through or document the invariant explicitly.

issues.description: Patch conflates relocation, visibility narrowing, and write-disabling into one commit
issues.detail: The diff bundles a pure move, an API-visibility decision, and a behavior change under `similarity index 9x%` headers that hide the semantic edits. Splitting into three patches (move-only, visibility/deprecation, write-disable) would make review tractable and the ABI implications obvious. Public symbols like NAME and calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval also deserve a deprecation cycle before demotion.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation to backward_codecs with read-only legacy formats is the right shape, but the patch needs work before landing. Three substantive issues recur across reviewers: a duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant breaking single-source-of-truth, write-disabling deferred to fieldsWriter rather than construction while SPI still hands out instances, and an inconsistent visibility contract on OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues (public class, package-private fields). Secondary cleanups include dead constructor parameters that lie about behavior and test scaffolding that hardcodes defaults. The patch should be split into separate move, visibility, and behavior-change commits.
